text:
Maya: follow-up from the SDK surface workshop: we need to settle the retry/resume affordances for streaming vs paged APIs across python/ts/go. i've got a short straw proposal.
Chris: shoot.
Maya: proposal summary:
- Streaming APIs: expose `resume_token` in-stream and a small `resume()` helper on the iterator. streaming auto-resume disabled by default; enable via `client.options.streamAutoResume=true` for advanced users.
- Paged APIs: automatic resume on idempotent list/read ops. SDKs must accept `resume_token` in the `ListResponse`.
- Transports: advertise `caps` header and `resume_mode` header (optimistic|explicit).
Evan: curious about stream ergonomics. if auto-resume disabled by default, how do simple users get reliability?
Maya: default path is paged endpoints for reliability. streaming is opt-in for low-latency use. docs will show patterns: use paged for large scans, stream for short-lived tailing.
Priya: add: SDKs should expose `streaming.backfill(resume_token)` for users who want to resume manually.
Chris: tests: add property-based tests that randomly drop connections mid-stream and assert (1) manual resume reproduces items after token, (2) auto-resume can be toggled off.
BuildBot: created task ENG-3402: "stream/paged resume test harness".
Evan: one more: pagination server-side might evict cursors early. SDK should check expires header and proactively refresh when `expires < now + prefetch_window` by fetching a new token (if server supports refresh endpoint).
Maya: yes. define `prefetch_window` default 10s. allow override per-client.
Priya: how to surface partial-page guarantees? e.g., server may return 200 with partial results and next_token. SDK should not treat partial-page as failure, but mark page as possibly truncated (meta flag) so caller can decide.
Chris: agree. add `page_truncated: true` on responses where server indicates it. docs will show how to detect and optionally re-run the same list with stricter limits.
Maya: language mapping: Python: `for r in client.list(...): if r.meta.page_truncated: ...` TS: streaming returns AsyncIterator with `resume()` on the iterator object. Go: provide `Stream` type with `Resume(ctx, token)`.
Evan: also add telemetry: SDKs should emit events: `resume_attempt`, `resume_success`, `resume_failure`, `token_expired`. expose these via hooks for customers.
Priya: security: runtime should mark tokens as sensitive; lib logs must redact token value and only log short digest.
Chris: let's put these into a concise RFC patch. I'll stub code examples for each lang.
Maya: thanks. actioning: Chris will open RFC PR with examples; Priya will spec CI tests; Evan will add telemetry hooks; I'll prototype small stream helper in python.
BuildBot: linked ENG-3402 to RFC PR 1234.
Maya: cool — done for today.
